note: Hand-checked ground truth for the extraction harness. Every expected value below was
read out of the source text in the same record by a person, not produced by a model.
That distinction is the whole point: a corpus generated by the models under test would
agree with itself by construction and measure nothing.
For a registry record the source document IS the JSON, so a label here is a
transcription rather than a clinical judgement - which is what makes a small corpus
defensible without a clinician. The excerpts are trimmed faithfully from
THIS CORPUS IS SMALL AND SAYS SO. Three cases cannot settle whether an agent pipeline
beats a single call. It is enough to make the harness real and the verdict mechanical;
widening it is curator time, and the plan's 0.2 dw for 'baseline + fixture corpus'
assumed labels that did not exist.
